name: Floorplan Mosque
summary: A mosque seen from above becomes an open courtyard, a prayer hall with a recessed mihrab, and a corner minaret footprint.
why: The substantial walls, recessed prayer niche, and offset square tower turn an architectural plan into a compact diagram. One broad division separates the prayer hall from the open courtyard. A clear gap in the lower wall marks the entrance.
risk: The mosque association is architectural and conceptual rather than immediate. The recessed mihrab and corner tower are easiest to understand at larger sizes.
sub1: A prayer hall oriented with purpose
reasonToChoose: A quiet architectural diagram feels more distinctive than a mosque elevation.

palette.name: FLOORPLAN MOSQUE / FOREST + PALE STONE + SAND
